title: 2009 Prairie's gable sweeps down to its neighbour, as photographed
items: In 1904, the tall shaped gable of 2009 Prairie Avenue no longer stops short on its south side: its stone coping now sweeps on down past the roof's edge to the wall it shares with 2011, about 10 m up, as the old photograph shows, and the brick corner and eave that stood above that line are gone.
